purpose: Teach: フィート/エアー/クロック/エリザベス/ミスター/ハワード/ルビー/パット

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国のフィート単位の身長表記のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was telling me about how Americans measure height in feet.
lines.style: Gentle, remembering tone. Soft entry. Nostalgic cadence, like recalling a small, shared moment. Warm toward Aoi.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、エアー、つまりエアフォースのスニーカーを愛用されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She said that customer really loves wearing Air Force sneakers.
lines.style: Observant, connecting-the-dots delivery. Light, almost fascinated by the detail. Slight upward inflection—noticing something about this person.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、クロックレディオの音色がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer mentioned she has a real fondness for the sound of old clock radios.
lines.style: Wondering, slightly charmed. Unhurried pace. Lets the oddness of the preference breathe—the kind of thing that sticks with you.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、英国エリザベス女王の戴冠式のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She was talking about Queen Elizabeth's coronation the other day.
lines.style: Engaged, leaning into the story. Animated but grounded—this was clearly a vivid conversation. Slight brightness in the middle.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ミスター・ビーンのコメディがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer's really into Mr. Bean's comedy, isn't she.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Gentle humor in the observation. Slight smile underneath. Not mocking—fond, the way you note someone's quirks.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、英米作家ハワードのSF小説を愛されてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She loves those science fiction novels by Howard, you know.
lines.style: Conversational certainty. Matter-of-fact but genuinely interested. The kind of detail you hold onto because it matters to the person.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、宝石のルビーをお好みだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer has a real preference for rubies as jewels.
lines.style: Thoughtful observation. Slightly lyrical—there's something elegant about the detail. Unhurried, noticing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ゴルフのパット練習のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She was telling me about her golf putting practice recently.
lines.style: Warm recall, slight amusement. Closing thought—gentle fade. The intimacy of someone sharing their small world with you.
